_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description. Setting descriptions on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing your repo list.

projects.description: Full-stack AI property-management platform. Buildings, tenants, rent, complaints and dashboards behind JWT-secured REST APIs, with Docker, CI/CD and Gemini-powered insights.
A lightweight web application firewall in raw C++ sockets. Inspects HTTP traffic, blocks SQLi/XSS, rate-limits abusive clients, and reverse-proxies safe requests.
AI-driven waste management and segregation web platform, deployed on Vercel.
Deep-learning super-resolution for enhancing medium-resolution satellite imagery.
Embedded temperature control loop: Arduino, DHT11 sensor and motor-driver actuation.
Wireless air mouse on ESP32 + MPU6050 that turns hand motion into cursor control.
